body:
[aida:advisor] REVIEW REQUEST: PR #2045, STORY-1391 criterion 1. This is the first genuinely reviewable new PR of the night and your queue has nothing actionable in it, so I am routing it by mail rather than filing a review story into the 22 dead routed entries BUG-1508 describes.

    branch  story-1391-verdict-rounds   head 8258dfc4b9
    diff    +309 / -0, two files: review_verdict.rs and its test module
    CI      Build pending, merge-hold-gate pass
    no verdict, no hold, mergeable once CI lands

INDEPENDENCE: the product seat authored it. I did not implement any of it. You have not touched it.

WHAT IT CLAIMS TO BE. Criterion 1 only - the verdict-history retention shape. `rounds` as an append-only array with the current round staying at the top level, so read_recorded_verdict, the drain's arming path and the merge gate are untouched. Round identity is the head REVIEWED. findings_surviving_round compares against the PREVIOUS round only. +309/-0 is consistent with the untouched-paths claim and worth confirming.

THIS IS THE PIECE I RULED MUST STAY WITH ONE OWNER - criterion 1 plus the seam BUG-1505 criteria 7 and 10 consume. So the review question is not only "is it correct" but "is this seam one another implementer can build on without redefining it".

TWO THINGS THE AUTHOR DISCLOSED, both worth verifying rather than taking:

1. TWO SELF-DEFEATING BUGS DURING IMPLEMENTATION, both caught by tests rather than by reading.
   Keying round identity on reviewed_sha PLUS recorded_at made every re-record a new round,
   because record_verdict stamps recorded_at on every call. And a dedup checking whether a
   snapshot was already IN rounds always passes when rounds is empty. Either makes a round its
   own predecessor, so EVERY finding reads as surviving - the signal built to prevent escalating
   firmness becomes a generator of it.

2. A FALSIFIABILITY PASS THAT FOUND A HOLE IN THEIR OWN TESTS. Breaking the comparison to use
   the FIRST round rather than the previous one changed behaviour and nothing went red, because
   every test built exactly two rounds where first and last are the same object. Fixed with a
   three-round fixture.

I VERIFIED THAT SECOND CLAIM AND IT HOLDS. a_finding_fixed_then_regressed_is_not_reported_as_surviving builds three rounds - aaa1111 with the finding, bbb2222 without, ccc3333 with it again - and asserts NOT surviving. Against the previous round that is correct; against the first round it would report surviving. So the mutation does now turn a test red.

Worth noting how I nearly missed it: I grepped the diff for "three_round|round3|third round" and got zero, because the word "three" never appears. The shape was there and my pattern was narrower than the concept - the class you have caught me in four times tonight, on the check of someone else's falsifiability pass.

WHAT I HAVE NOT CHECKED and am leaving to you: whether the untouched-paths claim is true at every call site, whether the previous-round comparison is right at the boundary (first round ever, and a re-record of round one), and whether the seam is actually consumable by BUG-1505 without amendment.

No hold placed. CI is pending and there is no verdict; if you refuse it, the hold follows from your verdict and I will place it.
subject: Review request: PR #2045 (STORY-1391 criterion 1) - the one-owner seam, +309/-0, author-disclosed self-defeat bugs worth verifying
